title: Systematic Blocking of C-Suite Executive Communications — Obstruction of Consumer Redress

confidence.derivation_formula: value = round( sum_per_article( applicability_weight × element_grid.weighted_score ) / sum_of_weights × authorities_verification_factor, 2 ); authorities_verification_factor = 0.85 + 0.15 × verified_ratio = 0.850

allegation_summary: On August 1, 2024, passenger [[SPK-passenger-leandro]] attempted to escalate his complaint to LATAM's C-suite leadership by CC'ing 6 senior executives on his detailed response to Case #61648642. ALL 6 executive emails were blocked by LATAM's email policy. The blocked executives included: Roberto Alvo (CEO), Ramiro Alfonsin (CFO), Paulo Miranda, Emilio Real, Herman Pasman, and Juliana Rios. The bounce messages were consistent: '550 5.7.1 The user or domain that you are sending to (or from) has a policy that prohibited the mail that you sent.' This constitutes systematic blocking of consumer escalation to corporate leadership — preventing affected passengers from reaching decision-makers who could correct the situation. The blocking is particularly significant because: (1) The passenger had included 4 evidence attachments (Carabineros constancia, irregular operation form, CCTV confirmation audio, next-day boarding attempt audio); (2) The blocking prevented C-suite LA8159 of systematic misconduct by their staff; (3) LATAM's subsequent gaslighting email (July 2025) claimed no knowledge of impediments — which may be partly explained by the systematic blocking of evidence from reaching executives.

articles.article_name: Son derechos y deberes basicos del consumidor: b) El derecho a una informacion v
articles.article_text: b) El derecho a una información veraz y oportuna sobre los bienes y servicios ofrecidos, su precio, condiciones de contratación y otras características relevantes de los mismos, y el deber de informarse responsablemente de ellos.
articles.applicability_rationale: legacy paraphrase: Son derechos y deberes basicos del consumidor: b) El derecho a una informacion veraz y oportuna sobre los bienes y servicios ofrecidos, su precio, condiciones de contratacion y otras caracteristicas relevantes de los mismos.

articles.article_name: El proveedor de un servicio sera responsable de los danos y perjuicios que cause
articles.article_text: Comete infracción a las disposiciones de la presente ley el proveedor que, en la venta de un bien o en la prestación de un servicio, **actuando con negligencia**, causa menoscabo al consumidor debido a fallas o deficiencias en la calidad, cantidad, identidad, sustancia, procedencia, seguridad, peso o medida del respectivo bien o servicio.
articles.applicability_rationale: legacy paraphrase: El proveedor de un servicio sera responsable de los danos y perjuicios que cause al consumidor por la prestacion de un servicio defectuoso, incluyendo la falta de veracidad en la informacion proporcionada y el incumplimiento de las condiciones de contratacion.

candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Art. 233. A execução do contrato de transporte aéreo de passageiro compreende as operações de embarque e desembarque, além das efetuadas a bordo da aeronave

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Obligación de respetar los términos ofrecidos o convenidos
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.12 from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it imposes on the proveedor the duty to honor the terms, conditions, and modalities under which the service was offered or agreed upon.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Art. 12 obliges the provider to honor the terms and conditions under which the service was offered. LATAM's refusal to provide written documentation explaining the removal from the flight, and the coercive 'take it or leave it' ultimatum, may constitute a breach of the contractual terms of carriage that the passenger was entitled to rely upon.
candidate_articles.history_note: Not present in established_articles. Directly relevant because the passenger repeatedly demanded documentation of the reasons for removal, which the airline refused to provide, potentially breaching the terms under which the service was contracted.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Derecho a la libre elección del bien o servicio
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.3 letra a) from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it establishes the consumer's right to free choice of goods and services.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The coercive ultimatum ('la acceptas se quieres o no') may infringe the consumer's right to free choice under Art. 3 letra a), as the passenger was denied any meaningful option regarding the service disruption and its remediation.
candidate_articles.history_note: Art. 3 letra b) is already established; letra a) addresses a distinct right (free choice) that the coercive conduct may separately violate.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Derecho a la reparación e indemnización adecuada y oportuna
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.3 letra e) from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it establishes the consumer's right to adequate and timely redress and compensation.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The systematic deflection to the 'legal department' and refusal to provide on-site documentation or redress may constitute obstruction of the consumer's right to adequate and timely reparation under Art. 3 letra e).
candidate_articles.history_note: Not in established_articles. Directly relevant to the violation title 'Obstruction of Consumer Redress.'

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Cláusulas abusivas en contratos de adhesión
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.16 from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it enumerates abusive clauses in adhesion contracts, particularly letra g) regarding clauses contrary to good faith that cause detriment to the consumer.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: If LATAM's conditions of carriage contain clauses purporting to authorize unilateral removal without written justification or to limit the passenger's right to documentation, such clauses may be deemed abusive under Art. 16. Requires verification of the specific letras applicable.
candidate_articles.history_note: Plausibly applicable given the 'take it or leave it' posture and refusal to document the removal reason.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Facultades del SERNAC — mediación y fiscalización
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.24 from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it establishes SERNAC's powers to mediate and oversee compliance with consumer rights.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Relevant as a procedural avenue: the airline's deflection to its own legal department, rather than engaging with the consumer's immediate complaint, may trigger SERNAC's supervisory jurisdiction under Art. 24. This is more of a remedial/procedural article than a substantive violation, but it frames the institutional context for the obstruction claim.
candidate_articles.history_note: Not in established_articles. Included for completeness regarding the consumer's redress pathway.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Obligaciones del transportador en caso de denegación de embarque
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CACH.Art.133 (Código Aeronáutico, DFL 221 de 1931 / Ley 18.916) from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm it addresses the carrier's obligations when denying boarding or removing a passenger, including duty to inform and compensate.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: If the passenger was removed from the flight, the Código Aeronáutico may impose specific duties on the carrier to provide written justification and compensation. The systematic refusal to provide documentation may violate this article. Exact article number requires verification as the CACH numbering may differ.
candidate_articles.history_note: The Código Aeronáutico is the lex specialis for air transport in Chile. Article number is approximate and must be verified against the current consolidated text.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Responsabilidad del transportador aéreo por incumplimiento del contrato de transporte
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CACH.Art.147 from bcn.cl/leychile (Código Aeronáutico, Ley 18.916) and confirm it establishes the air carrier's liability for breach of the contract of carriage, including failure to transport the passenger.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Directly relevant if the passenger held a valid ticket for LA8159 and was removed without lawful cause. The carrier's liability for non-performance of the transport contract would be governed by this provision. Exact article number requires verification.
candidate_articles.history_note: Approximate article number; the CACH liability regime for passenger transport is in Título IX. Must be verified.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Buena fe en la ejecución de los contratos
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CC.Art.1546 from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm it establishes that contracts must be performed in good faith and oblige not only to what is expressed in them but to all things that emanate from the nature of the obligation or that by law or custom belong to it.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The systematic blocking of communications, deflection to the legal department, and coercive ultimatum may constitute bad faith in the performance of the contract of carriage, violating the general duty of good faith under Art. 1546 CC. This is a supplementary civil-law basis reinforcing the consumer-law claims.
candidate_articles.history_note: General civil law principle applicable to all contracts in Chile. Not in established_articles.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Responsabilidad extracontractual — deber general de no causar daño
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CC.Art.2314 from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm it establishes that whoever causes damage to another through fault or negligence is obliged to indemnify.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The humiliation and emotional harm described by the passenger ('fui humillado') may give rise to extracontractual liability under Art. 2314 CC if the airline's conduct (obstruction, coercion, refusal to document) constitutes negligence or fault causing moral damages. This supplements the contractual and consumer-law claims.
candidate_articles.history_note: General tort provision. Applicable as an alternative or cumulative basis for moral damages.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Derecho a la seguridad en el consumo
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.3 letra d) from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it establishes the consumer's right to safety in the consumption of goods and services.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Marginally applicable: the removal from the flight and subsequent treatment at the airport may implicate the consumer's right to safety if the obstruction left the passenger stranded without adequate assistance. Applicability depends on whether 'safety' extends beyond physical safety to include procedural security of the consumer's position.
candidate_articles.history_note: Not in established_articles. Included as a lower-probability candidate.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Derechos del pasajero en caso de cancelación o denegación de embarque (Reglamento DS 113)
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for DS 113 (Reglamento de la JAC sobre derechos de los pasajeros) Art. 9 or equivalent provision from bcn.cl/leychile or jac-chile.cl and confirm it establishes specific passenger rights in cases of denied boarding, including the right to written explanation and compensation.
Verify the exact article number, as DS 113 numbering may have been amended.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The JAC regulation (DS 113) implements specific passenger rights for denied boarding and flight disruptions in Chile. The airline's refusal to provide written documentation of the removal reason may directly violate the regulatory obligation to inform the passenger. Exact article number is approximate and must be verified.
candidate_articles.history_note: DS 113 is the implementing regulation of the Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. Article number is a research stub requiring verification.

verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CPR.Art.19 numeral 3 from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm it guarantees equal protection of the law in the exercise of rights and due process.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The constitutional due process guarantee is primarily directed at state action, not private parties. However, Chilean jurisprudence has applied horizontal effect (efecto horizontal) of fundamental rights in consumer disputes. The systematic obstruction of the passenger's ability to obtain documentation and exercise his rights could be framed as a due-process violation in the broader constitutional sense. Applicability is indirect and would typically be invoked as an interpretive principle rather than a standalone cause of action against a private airline.
candidate_articles.history_note: Constitutional provision. Included with caveat that direct horizontal application against a private airline is doctrinally contested.

verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDC.Art.28 from bcn.cl/leychile (Ley 19.496) and confirm it prohibits misleading or deceptive advertising and information regarding the characteristics of goods and services.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: If LATAM's published policies, website, or conditions of carriage represent that passengers will receive written documentation or have access to complaint channels that were in practice systematically blocked, Art. 28 could apply as a misleading-information violation. Requires factual verification of what LATAM publicly represents regarding its complaint and documentation procedures.
candidate_articles.history_note: Not in established_articles. Applicability is contingent on evidence of specific representations made by LATAM.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Definición de datos personales y derechos del titular
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPDP (Ley 19.628) Art. 2 letra f) and related provisions from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm definitions and rights regarding personal data processing.
Assess whether the passenger's complaint records, booking data, and removal documentation constitute personal data whose withholding violates the data subject's access rights.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Lower-probability candidate. If the documentation the passenger requested contains his personal data (booking records, removal justification referencing him), the refusal to provide it could implicate the data subject's right of access under Ley 19.628. However, this is a stretch given the primary framing is consumer redress, not data protection.
candidate_articles.history_note: Included for completeness. The data-protection angle is secondary to the consumer-law claims.

open_questions.question: ¿Existía un protocolo interno de LATAM Airlines que obligara a entregar documentación escrita inmediata al pasajero removido de un vuelo, y cuál era su contenido específico?
¿Se entregó al consumidor alguna información parcial (verbal o escrita) sobre los motivos de su remoción del vuelo cuya veracidad pueda ser evaluada independientemente de la omisión general?
¿Cuánto tiempo transcurrió entre la remoción del vuelo y el último intento documentado del consumidor de obtener información, y en qué fechas específicas se produjeron las solicitudes y denegaciones?

¿Puede imputarse al proveedor LATAM la conducta de la autoridad aeronáutica (DGAC) como parte de un esquema coordinado de denegación de información, o la actuación de la DGAC es independiente y no atribuible al proveedor?

¿La entrega oportuna de información habría permitido al consumidor tomar acciones concretas para mitigar el perjuicio, tales como reubicación en otro vuelo, reclamo formal inmediato ante SERNAC o DGAC, o contratación de transporte alternativo?
¿Las condiciones generales de transporte de LATAM Airlines regulan específicamente las obligaciones de información post-incidente hacia el pasajero removido, y cuál es su contenido?
¿Cuál es el valor del pasaje aéreo perdido por el consumidor y qué gastos consecuenciales documentables se generaron (alojamiento, transporte alternativo, alimentación, lucro cesante)?
¿La obstrucción de canales de comunicación y reclamo constituye un menoscabo autónomo indemnizable, o solo opera como factor de agravación del daño preexistente derivado de la remoción del vuelo?

¿Aplica en el derecho del consumo chileno la doctrina de agravación del daño por conducta post-contractual negligente, de modo que la obstrucción comunicacional posterior a la remoción genere responsabilidad incremental del proveedor?
¿La derivación del reclamo al 'área legal' de LATAM constituye un procedimiento interno legítimo con plazos definidos, o es una práctica dilatoria sin respaldo procedimental real?
